Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{3: 'The sudden turn of events sends a wave of unease through the crew.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}

{3: "Your mind races through possible responses while another thought cuts in. The briefing did mention pirates, and the first officer had spoken about how common they were in these waters. You simply hadn't expected them to become an active part of the battle."}
{3: 'Is this a penalty for letting the simulation run too long, or was this always part of the scenario?'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{3: "Whatever the answer, there's no time to think about it. A deafening impact erupts at close range."}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryExplosionL.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '1'}
{3: "The pirates' opening volley strikes the flagship's port side before anyone has time to react."}

{3: "Let both sides weaken each other, then move in for the kill—it's one of the oldest tactics in these waters. And right now, your fleet has taken more damage than Red's, making you the easier target."}
{3: 'The armor on that side has already endured repeated hits throughout the battle. Its remaining protection is dangerously thin.'}
{3: 'The bad news follows immediately.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Port armor breached! The engine room is flooding!', 4: '1', 18: '100020432'}
{2: 'Damage control, focus everything on sealing the breach.', 3: '28'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: '...Report from the forward section! The flooding has exceeded containment capacity!', 4: '1', 18: '100020433'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Damage control needs more time!', 4: '1', 18: '100020434'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '3'}
{3: 'Several markers on the fleet-status display begin to flicker weakly.'}
{3: 'It means those vessels are critically damaged.'}
{3: "The pirates in these waters have built their fleet almost entirely from stolen ships and weapons, and they've amassed an alarming amount of firepower."}

{3: 'They have no discipline and no concern for military restraint. They simply fire everything they have. In the chaos of a short engagement, that makes them even more dangerous than a trained navy.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 5: '2'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 5: '3'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.6', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Two markers on the screen flicker several times, then go dark one after the other.'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0.6', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{3: 'Everyone in the room understands what that means.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant, our losses are far beyond projections. Available forces are still falling.', 4: '1', 18: '100020435'}
{2: 'Redirect our guns and focus on the pirates.', 3: '51'}
{2: 'Deploy every rescue vessel.', 3: '52'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Are you sure we should turn our guns away?', 4: '1', 18: '100020436'}
{2: "Red hasn't fired.", 3: '55'}
{2: 'If they truly wanted to finish us...', 3: '56', 4: 'If they were waiting for an opportunity...', 5: '56'}
{2: "We'd already be caught in a crossfire.", 3: '57'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "Alright. Then we'll take the chance!", 4: '1', 18: '100020438'}
{3: 'Despite the immediate counterattack, contact with the port-side damage-control team is lost.'}
{3: 'At least four galleons and several vanguard ships are closing in from two directions, forming a pincer.'}
{2: "First formation, move against the pirates' left flank. Don't let them lock onto the flagship.", 3: '62'}
{2: 'Second destroyer formation, circle around their right and disrupt their firing rhythm.', 3: '63'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480haituNormal01.png'}
{3: "Several vanguard ships are now less than a hundred meters away. At their current speed, they'll reach the flagship within moments. They're clearly preparing to board."}
{3: 'Your ships drive them back quickly, but the armed merchant vessels are right behind them. The constant attacks make it almost impossible for damage control to work.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant, I request permission to take personal command of the first formation!', 4: '1', 18: '100020439'}

{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "If the pirates board while the engine room is flooding, the flagship won't survive the close-range assault. I'll draw them away and buy damage control some time!", 4: '1', 18: '100020440'}
{2: 'Approved.', 3: '73', 4: 'Transferring ships now is too dangerous.', 5: '74'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Yes, Commandant!', 4: '1', 18: '100020441'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "You're the last person who should be worrying about that.", 4: '1', 18: '100020442'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "I'm heading out.", 4: '1', 18: '100020443'}
{3: 'He contacts the formation, makes the dangerous transfer to the destroyer flagship, and leads the squadron toward the pirates.'}
{1: "Under his command, the first formation quickly settles into position and draws most of the pirates' fire with a relentless counterattack.", 5: '3'}
{1: 'With a battle-hardened first officer leading the way, every command is carried out with speed and precision. Even the occasional bursts of firepower are more decisive than expected.'}
{1: 'You barely have time to feel relieved before something begins to trouble you.', 7: '1'}
{2: "Something's wrong...", 3: '82'}
{2: "We don't have enough ammunition to keep firing at this rate.", 3: '83'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1582.jpg', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '11'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Gray Flag, this is First Formation. Our ammunition is almost gone.', 4: '11', 18: '100020444'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Gray Flag, First Formation is out of ammunition. We only have small arms left for self-defense.', 4: '11', 18: '100020445'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'BOOM—BOOM—'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Requesting access to secondary channel.', 4: '11', 18: '100020446'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'Commandant, this ship has nothing left to fire.', 4: '11', 18: '100020447'}
{2: 'Return to the main fleet immediately.', 3: '103'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "I've already ordered the rest of the formation to withdraw.", 4: '11', 18: '100020448'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "But that won't be enough, Commandant.", 4: '11', 18: '100020449'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'An empty ship is still a weapon.', 4: '11', 18: '100020450'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "We've already taken out three of their galleons. I can take one more with me.", 4: '11', 18: '100020451'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: "There's no other way, Commandant.", 4: '11', 18: '100020452'}

{3: "His voice remains powerful, but the seriousness from his earlier reports is gone. Instead, he sounds like he's simply making small talk before the final battle—relaxed, nostalgic, and at peace."}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'This is why I became a soldier.', 4: '11', 18: '100020453'}
{2: 'Gray First Officer', 3: 'If I die protecting people from pirates, then at least I stayed true to why I enlisted.', 4: '11', 18: '100020454'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryTongxunHalfNew.prefab', 5: '11'}
{3: 'The channel goes dead.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '4'}
{3: "On the display, the destroyer's marker begins to move. Carrying only one person, it pulls away from the flagship and heads straight toward the four galleons in the center."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 5: '4'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{2: 'First and second formations, press both flanks!', 3: '125'}
{3: "You have to clear a path for him. The pirates can't be allowed to intercept or sink his ship before it reaches them."}
{3: 'Your fleet intensifies its fire, forcing the galleons to turn and respond.'}
{3: "They don't understand what the approaching ship intends to do."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1145.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '5'}
{3: 'The marker continues across the screen, closing in.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{3: 'The explosion is heavier than any cannon volley before it. The deep, crushing impact seems to strike through your entire body.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiActivityBriefBase/FxUiActivityBriefShining01.prefab', 5: '5'}
{3: "The ship's marker disappears from the display."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: "He said he'd grown up among fishing families and watched too many of them lose everything to pirates.", 5: '3'}
{1: "He said this was why he'd become a soldier."}
{1: 'He kept that promise with his life. He never retreated before the enemy or shied away from danger. For a sailor, the sea is the final destination. For a soldier, it is duty.', 7: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryMovieFilm.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'Outside the porthole, smoke still hangs over the center of the battlefield, while burning wreckage drifts across the water.'}
{3: 'The first officer bought enough time for the remaining damage-control crews to stabilize the worst of the breaches.'}
{3: "The flooding can't be stopped entirely, but for the moment, the ship can finally breathe."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiHuijinNew.prefab'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}

{1: "Continuing to fight both the pirates and Red is impossible. You're facing two fronts with less than forty percent ammunition, while the flagship is still taking on water. You can't handle everything at once.", 5: '3'}
{1: "Could you turn the pirates against Red? No. That would take time to arrange, and time is the one thing you don't have."}
{1: 'Every second that passes is paid for in seawater pouring into the hull, fire from enemy guns, and the lives of your soldiers.'}
{1: 'If this continues, there is only one possible outcome: the entire fleet will be destroyed.'}
{1: "The opening the first officer bought with his life has only delayed the inevitable for Gray's exhausted fleet.", 7: '1'}
{2: 'Is there really no other way...?', 3: '169'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1595.jpg'}
{3: 'You pull your eyes away from the display and look out through the porthole.'}
{1: "Red's fleet remains motionless in the open water.", 5: '3'}
{1: "Even after the pirates arrived and your fleet suffered such heavy damage, Red hasn't moved in to finish you."}
{1: "That isn't the optimal choice for an automated opponent. Any system focused solely on victory would've joined the pirates' attack and destroyed Gray immediately."}
{1: 'But Red held back.'}
{1: "Something from the pre-battle appendix returns to you—the old alliance's white-dominant flag, along with its system of signal flags...", 7: '1'}
{2: 'First officer, do you remember the old alliance...', 3: '181'}
{3: 'No answer comes. Only then do you remember that the other steady presence in the operations room is gone.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1596.jpg'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You leave the operations room, and a soldier with the look of a clerk hurries over.'}
{2: 'Informant', 3: 'Commandant, what do you need?', 4: '1', 18: '100020455'}
{2: 'What flags do we have in storage?', 3: '189'}
{2: 'Yes. We need to raise a different one.', 3: '191'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: "On Red's side..."}
{3: 'Adelyde stands at the bow, watching the pirate sails draw closer from the northwest before turning her gaze toward the Gray flagship.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Ma'am, Gray is trapped between us and the pirates! This is our chance to finish them! Your orders?", 4: '1', 18: '100020457'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'All units, halt your advance. Keep every gun loaded, but hold your fire.', 4: '2', 18: '100020458'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'I said hold your fire.', 4: '2', 18: '100020460'}
{3: 'Her voice remains calm, but the finality in it leaves no room for argument. The first officer reluctantly falls silent.'}
{3: "This isn't mercy. Adelyde has never been indecisive. What stays her hand is the respect that has built over the long hours of battle."}
{3: 'The student across the water thinks much as she does. They brought an inferior fleet this far through clear judgment, weighing the cost of every decision before making it.'}
{3: "Adelyde can't bring herself to attack them now, when they have no chance to fight back."}
{3: 'She speaks softly, almost hoping the wind will carry the question across the sea.'}
{3: 'As if in answer, a new flag begins to rise above the Gray flagship.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Ma'am, the Gray flagship is raising a new flag! It may be a surrender signal!", 4: '1', 18: '100020462'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1587.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/IconMovie/V480jiubangqiNormal01.png', 5: '-150'}
{3: 'She raises her binoculars and studies it carefully.'}
{3: 'There was another white flag in the historical material she reviewed before the battle.'}
{3: "The flag on Gray's mainmast is white, but it isn't the plain white of surrender. A gray-and-red emblem marks one corner."}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront13.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1593.jpg'}
{1: "There is no mistaking it. They're flying the banner of the former maritime alliance. But why raise it now?", 5: '1'}
{1: 'Below it, a soldier is sending another message with signal flags.'}
{1: "This isn't surrender. If Gray intended to concede, they could do so through the system. The simulation would end immediately, making the flag unnecessary."}
{1: 'But the battle is still ongoing.'}

{1: 'The student read an appendix that seemed unrelated to the battle, remembered a flag both factions had abandoned, and chose to raise it now—with ammunition running low, the engine room flooding, and pirates closing in.'}
{1: "It's a blind gamble on the possibility that the two sides can still stand together—or even make peace.", 7: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'So they actually read the appendix.', 4: '1', 18: '100020465'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: '"If you want peace, prepare for war"... I see. An exceptional soldier.', 4: '1', 18: '100020466'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Red First Officer', 3: "Awaiting orders, ma'am!", 4: '2', 18: '100020468'}
{2: 'Adelyde', 3: 'Open a public communications channel.', 4: '1', 18: '100020469'}
{1: 'She recognizes the signal. It carries words that have been buried beneath decades of cannon fire between the two factions: Requesting parley.', 3: '40'}
{2: 'She recognizes the signal. It carries words that have been buried beneath decades of cannon fire between the two factions: Requesting parley.'}
